tools.name: read_active_tab
tools.description: Read the user's currently active Chrome tab through their real, logged-in browser profile. Returns the page URL, title, and cleaned readable text. Use when WebFetch/fetch is blocked by a 403, login wall, or bot detection.

tools.name: open_and_read_url
tools.description: Open a URL in a background Chrome tab using the user's real browser profile (cookies and login sessions included), extract its readable text, then close the tab. For pages behind logins, paywalls-with-session, or bot checks that defeat server-side fetchers.

url.description: http(s) URL to open and read
